history.content: Hi, my phone suddenly has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send or receive picture messages. Can you help?

I can help you troubleshoot your phone’s service and picture messaging issues. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide either your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth?
Sure, my name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you, Sofia. I’ll help you troubleshoot your service and picture messaging issues.

To proceed, I’ll need you to perform a quick check on your phone:
1. Can you check your phone’s status bar and let me know what icons you see at the top (especially if you see an airplane icon, “No Signal,” or anything unusual)?
2. Are you able to see any signal bars at all, or does it say “No Service” or “No Signal”?

This will help me determine the next steps. If you need instructions on how to check, let me know!
I see an Airplane Mode icon and 'No Signal' in the status bar. My phone says 'No Service' and I can't get any signal at all.

It looks like Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone, which turns off all wireless connections—including cellular service. This is likely why you have no signal and can’t send or receive messages.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. Once you do, check if your signal bars return and if you can use your service again. Let me know what happens after you turn off Airplane Mode.
Airplane mode is now off, but my phone still shows 'No Service' and there are no signal bars. What should I try next?

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no service, the next step is to check your SIM card status. Sometimes, the SIM card may not be properly seated or could have an issue.

Could you please check your SIM card status on your phone? If you need guidance on how to do this, let me know. Once you check, please tell me if your phone says the SIM is active, missing, or locked.
My SIM card status says it's active. What should I do next?

Since your SIM card is active but you still have no service, the next step is to check your phone’s network settings—specifically the APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can cause a complete loss of service.

Could you please check your APN settings and let me know if anything looks incorrect or if there’s an error message? If you’re unsure how to check, I can guide you through the process.
I checked my APN settings. The APN name shows as 'fast.telecom.net', but the status says 'Not set'. There is also an MMSC URL listed. What should I do next?

Thank you for checking. Since your APN status says “Not set,” this could be causing your service issue. The best next step is to reset your APN settings to the default values.

Please reset your APN settings on your phone. After resetting, you’ll need to restart (reboot) your device for the changes to take effect.

Let me know once you’ve reset the APN and restarted your phone, and if your service returns. If you need instructions on how to do this, just let me know!
I reset the APN settings and rebooted my phone as you asked, but I still have no service—it's still showing 'No Service' and no signal bars.
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer Sofia Martinez has no cellular service ('No Service', no signal bars) despite line and SIM being active. Airplane Mode is off, SIM is active, APN reset and device rebooted, but issue persists. Needs advanced technical support.
